diagram_math_checks.relations: Each elementary square represents h_{p,q-1}v_{p,q}+v_{p-1,q}h_{p,q}=0, not equality of paths. Each adjacent horizontal pair and vertical pair composes to zero. Boundary arrows into negative indices have zero target and are omitted.
diagram_math_checks.justification: These are the three axioms in def-homological-double-complex. The Remarks explicitly warns about anticommutation and no commutativity annotation is drawn.

diagram_math_checks.filtration: Shading contains precisely the displayed columns p=0,1 and excludes p=2. It is a cutoff picture, not a claim that these nine objects exhaust C. Only diagonal terms p+q=n enter F^col_1 T_n.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Checked the formula and preservation argument in def-row-and-column-filtrations-of-a-first-quadrant-double-complex: h lowers p and v preserves p, so both preserve p≤1.
